simple-value.value-expression: Apontamentos da Montagem Final
Conferência da Expedição
Divergências Produção vs Expedição

grid.expression: SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, SUM(APA.QTDAPONTADA) AS PRODUCAO, APO.CODUSU || ' - ' || (SELECT NOMEUSU FROM TSIUSU WHERE CODUSU = APO.CODUSU) AS APONTADOR, PRO.AD_LINHA FROM TPRAPA APA INNER JOIN TPRAPO APO ON APA.NUAPO = APO.NUAPO INNER JOIN TPRIATV TV ON APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV INNER JOIN TPREFX FX ON TV.IDEFX = FX.IDEFX INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON APA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD WHERE TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) = TO_CHAR(:P_DTBASE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND FX.DESCRICAO IN ('MONTAGEM FINAL') GROUP BY PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, APO.CODUSU,PRO.AD_LINHA ORDER BY PRO.CODPROD

SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, SUM(APA.QTDAPONTADA) AS PRODUCAO, APO.CODUSU || ' - ' || (SELECT NOMEUSU FROM TSIUSU WHERE CODUSU = APO.CODUSU) AS APONTADOR, PRO.AD_LINHA FROM TPRAPA APA INNER JOIN TPRAPO APO ON APA.NUAPO = APO.NUAPO INNER JOIN TPRIATV TV ON APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV INNER JOIN TPREFX FX ON TV.IDEFX = FX.IDEFX INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON APA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD WHERE TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) = TO_CHAR(:P_DTBASE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND FX.DESCRICAO IN ('EXPEDIÇÃO/CONFERENCIA') GROUP BY PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, APO.CODUSU, PRO.AD_LINHA ORDER BY PRO.CODPROD

SELECT COALESCE(P1.CODPROD, P2.CODPROD) AS CODPROD, COALESCE(P1.DESCRPROD, P2.DESCRPROD) AS DESCRPROD, P1.PRODUCAO AS PRODUCAO_APONTADA, P2.PRODUCAO AS EXPEDICAO_RECEBIDA, (COALESCE(P1.PRODUCAO, 0) - COALESCE(P2.PRODUCAO, 0)) AS DIFERENCA FROM (SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, SUM(APA.QTDAPONTADA) AS PRODUCAO FROM TPRAPA APA INNER JOIN TPRAPO APO ON APA.NUAPO = APO.NUAPO INNER JOIN TPRIATV TV ON APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV INNER JOIN TPREFX FX ON TV.IDEFX = FX.IDEFX INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON APA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD WHERE TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) = TO_CHAR(:P_DTBASE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND FX.DESCRICAO IN ('MONTAGEM FINAL') GROUP BY PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD) P1 FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, SUM(APA.QTDAPONTADA) AS PRODUCAO FROM TPRAPA APA INNER JOIN TPRAPO APO ON APA.NUAPO = APO.NUAPO INNER JOIN TPRIATV TV ON APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV INNER JOIN TPREFX FX ON TV.IDEFX = FX.IDEFX INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON APA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD WHERE TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) = TO_CHAR(:P_DTBASE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND FX.DESCRICAO IN ('EXPEDIÇÃO/CONFERENCIA') GROUP BY PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD) P2 ON P1.CODPROD = P2.CODPROD WHERE COALESCE(P1.PRODUCAO, 0) != COALESCE(P2.PRODUCAO, 0) OR P1.CODPROD IS NULL OR P2.CODPROD IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(P1.CODPROD, P2.CODPROD)
